favoriteFoldersHint: Use them as Copy To or Move To destinations, or add them to the menu. Removing a folder here only takes it off the list; the folder itself stays.
addFavoriteHint: Add a project or archive folder to open it straight from Finder.
favoriteUnavailable: The favorite folder is disabled, missing, or unavailable.
menuArrangeHint: Drag to reorder · Double-click to rename · Add items from New, Open With, or Favorite Folders.
menuNameHint: Leave empty to use the original name.
aboutBlurb: Adds New File, Copy Path, Compress, and Hash to the Finder context menu.
addFileTemplateHint: Supports text, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and RTF documents.
alreadyInFolder: It is already in this folder
bannerExtensionOff: The Finder extension is still off
chooseSameFormat: Choose a template in the same format
compareNeedsTwo: Comparing hashes needs exactly two files
configReadFailed: The settings file could not be read: {cause}
createdButOpenFailed: Created {name}, but could not open it: {cause}
creationListHint: Click the pencil to edit · Drag the handle on the left to reorder.
deleteFileTypeBody: The custom type and its menu item will be deleted. Existing files are kept.
deleteMoreItems: …and {count, plural, one {# more item} other {# more items}}
deletePermanentlyQuestion: Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} permanently?
deleteRefused: Not deleted: {path} is a disk root or your home folder.
deletedItems: Permanently deleted {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
diagnosticsIntro: Turn on the Finder extension before the menu appears in Finder.
documentFormatMismatch: The template does not match the {extension} format
documentPartMissing: The document is missing a part: {name}
documentPartTooLarge: A document part is too large: {name}
editorsHint: Turn on “Add to Menu” to give an app its own entry. Arrange entries in Context Menu. Removing an app here only takes it off this list.
enableTypeHint: Turned off, this type is hidden from the menu. Its settings are kept.
errURLNoApp: The link has no app name
extensionEnableFailed: Could not turn on the Finder extension
extensionOpenHint: Open RightClick in the Extensions list in System Settings.
finderReadFailed: Could not read the Finder setting: {cause}: {output}
finderValueInvalid: The Finder hidden-files setting is not 0 or 1: {value}
finderWriteFailed: Could not write the Finder setting: {cause}: {output}
finishEditingFirst: Save or cancel the current file type edit before importing another template.
folderIntoItself: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself
invalidName: Enter a valid name. A file name cannot contain a path separator.
keepFormatHint: Keeps the original document format. Edit the content in the matching app.
languageHint: The app's windows and menus use this language. The Finder menu follows it too.
launchAtLoginHint: Starts RightClick when you log in to macOS.
updateHint: Opens the newest release on GitHub in your browser. You download and install it yourself.
menuIntro: Common actions stay in the main menu; everything else goes in the RightClick submenu.
newIntro: Create files in the current folder. All types sit under New File.
noEditorsBody: Click “Add App…” to pick one from the Applications folder.
openAfterCreateHint: Opens with the default app for the format.
openersIntro: Each app in this list gets its own “Open with …” item. “Open with Terminal” always uses Terminal.
previewLiveHint: Updates as you change the menu.
previewSearchHint: Search filters the list below; the preview still shows the full menu.
readyInFinderBody: Right-click in any folder to see the RightClick menu.
restartFinderBody: Finder windows will close and reopen.
restartFinderHint: Quits Finder; macOS reopens it. Try this if the menu does not appear.
restoreDefaultsBody: This replaces the current menu items, order, locations, and enabled states.
sameNameExists: A template with this name already exists. Replace the template in Edit.
setLoginFailed: Could not change Open at Login
showCount: Shows {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
statusNeedsExtension: The extension must be turned on
templateNameExists: A template with this name already exists
templateNameInvalid: A template name cannot be used as a file name: {name}
templateNotText: Only text files can be templates.
templateReadFailed: The template file could not be read: {cause}
templateRegularFileOnly: Choose a regular file to use as a template.
templateTooLarge: A template file cannot be larger than 16 MB
unzipPartial: Extracted {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, then failed: {cause}
unzipWritten: Extracted {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

archiveTooLarge: The archive would expand to more than 2 GiB, so nothing was extracted.
archiveTooManyItems: The archive holds more than 10,000 items, so nothing was extracted.

documentTooLarge: The Office document is too large to check safely.
windowOpenFailed: The settings window could not be opened
foldersIntro: Folders you use often. Copy To and Move To can send items to them, and they can join the menu.
